from solution import check_tuplex


def test_issue_example():
    """Example: 'r' exists within tuple returns True."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e", "s", "o", "u", "r", "c", "e"), "r")
    assert result == True  # 9+1=10 items, match at index 2 -> True literal


def test_issue_first_element_present():
    """Exists within tuple includes first element."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e"), "w")
    assert result == True  # 3+1=4 items, match at index 0 -> True literal


def test_issue_last_element_present():
    """Exists within tuple includes last element."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e"), "e")
    assert result == True  # 3+1=4 items, match at index 3 -> True literal


def test_issue_absent_element():
    """Missing element within tuple returns False."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e", "s", "o", "u", "r", "c", "e"), "z")
    assert result == False  # 9+1=10 items, 0 matches -> False literal


def test_issue_empty_tuple():
    """Empty tuple contains no element so returns False."""
    result = check_tuplex((), "r")
    assert result == False  # 0+0=0 items, 0 matches -> False literal


def test_issue_singleton_present():
    """Single-element tuple boundary present returns True."""
    result = check_tuplex((42,), 42)
    assert result == True  # 0+1=1 items, match at index 0 -> True literal


def test_issue_singleton_absent():
    """Single-element tuple boundary absent returns False."""
    result = check_tuplex((42,), 43)
    assert result == False  # 0+1=1 items, 0 matches -> False literal


def test_issue_int_string_distinct():
    """Integer 3 does not equal string '3' within tuple."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e"), "3")
    assert result == False  # 3+1=4 items, 0 equal elements -> False literal


def test_issue_substring_not_element():
    """Substring 'b' is not an element of ('ab', 'cd')."""
    result = check_tuplex(("ab", "cd"), "b")
    assert result == False  # 1+1=2 items, substring only -> False literal


def test_issue_case_sensitive():
    """Check is case sensitive so 'R' differs from 'r'."""
    result = check_tuplex(("w", 3, "r", "e"), "R")
    assert result == False  # 3+1=4 items, 0 exact matches -> False literal


def test_contract_true_is_bool():
    """Function returns boolean True for existing element."""
    result = check_tuplex((1, 2, 3), 2)
    assert result is True  # 2+1=3 items, match at index 1 -> True literal


def test_contract_false_is_bool():
    """Function returns boolean False for missing element."""
    result = check_tuplex((1, 2, 3), 9)
    assert result is False  # 2+1=3 items, 0 matches -> False literal
